name: Python virtual environment (venv)
purpose: Keeps the libraries for this project separate from other projects, so versions do not clash and your setup can be repeated.
version_guidance: venv is part of Python. No separate download is needed.

windows.text: In your project folder, create the environment.
Activate it. Do this each time you open a new terminal.

macos.text: In your project folder, create the environment.
Activate it. Do this each time you open a new terminal.

linux.text: In your project folder, create the environment.
Activate it. Do this each time you open a new terminal.

windows.expected: The first line ends with .venv\Scripts\python.exe inside your project folder

macos.expected: A path ending with .venv/bin/python inside your project folder

linux.expected: A path ending with .venv/bin/python inside your project folder

common_problems.problem: Windows PowerShell says running scripts is disabled when you activate
common_problems.solution: Use Command Prompt instead of PowerShell for the activate command. Ask your supervisor or IT before changing any security setting.

common_problems.problem: Linux: "ensurepip is not available" when creating the environment
common_problems.solution: Install the python3-venv package for your distribution, then try again.

common_problems.problem: Your terminal prompt does not show (.venv)
common_problems.solution: The environment is not active. Run the activate command again from the project folder.

manual_review: The verification commands (where and which) are standard shell commands, not quoted from the Python pages.
